name: ExtractRegexToColumnsNode
label: Extract Regex to Columns
description: Applies a regular expression with capture groups to a column; each capture group becomes a new column.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table containing the source column.

fields.name: SourceColumn
fields.label: Source Column
fields.description: The name of the column to which the regular expression is applied.

fields.name: RegularExpression
fields.label: Regular Expression
fields.description: The regular expression pattern. Each capture group becomes a new column.

fields.name: ColumnPrefix
fields.label: Column Prefix
fields.description: The prefix for the generated columns, e.g., 'Group' produces Group1, Group2, etc.

fields.name: ExtractedDataTable
fields.label: Extracted Data Table
fields.description: The data table with the extracted capture-group columns appended.
